## Short Bio

Paavo Sattler is a researcher in statistics working on methodological problems in multivariate, high-dimensional, and nonparametric inference. He is currently a researcher at TU Dortmund University and RWTH Aachen University. His research interests include structured and directional hypotheses, multiple testing, resampling-based methods, covariance and correlation structures, and statistical computing. A recurring theme in his work is the development of methods that connect mathematical questions with practical statistical inference and software implementation.

He received his doctorate in statistics from TU Dortmund University in 2021 with a thesis on inference for multivariate and high-dimensional data in heterogeneous designs. In 2024, he held an interim professorship in Mathematical Statistics at Heidelberg University. His current work includes methodological research, software development, and collaborations in which existing statistical methods can be applied, adapted, or extended to new problems.
